description: Rank the Tyr-alphaB1 domains among all profiled domains and compare their P-2 residue preference profile with pooled His-alphaB1 domains
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

r = pd.read_csv("profaff_alphaB1_vs_classI_preference.csv")
H = r[r.alphaB1=="H"]; Y = r[r.alphaB1=="Y"]
print("profiled domains:", len(r), " His:", len(H), " Tyr:", len(Y))
for _, q in Y.iterrows():
    pct = 100*(r.log2_OR_classI < q.log2_OR_classI).mean()
    pctH = 100*(H.log2_OR_classI < q.log2_OR_classI).mean()
    print(f"{q.pdz:10s} log2OR={q.log2_OR_classI:5.2f}  Fisher p={q.fisher_p:.2e}  "
          f"percentile among all 113 = {pct:.0f}   among 71 His domains = {pctH:.0f}")
u = stats.mannwhitneyu(Y.log2_OR_classI.values, H.log2_OR_classI.values, alternative="less")
print(f"\nMann-Whitney, Tyr log2OR < His log2OR: U={u.statistic:.1f}, p={u.pvalue:.4f}  (n=3 vs 71)")
print(f"His median log2OR {H.log2_OR_classI.median():.2f} (IQR {H.log2_OR_classI.quantile(.25):.2f}-{H.log2_OR_classI.quantile(.75):.2f}); "
      f"Tyr {Y.log2_OR_classI.median():.2f} (range {Y.log2_OR_classI.min():.2f}-{Y.log2_OR_classI.max():.2f})")

# P-2 residue preference profiles
df = pd.read_excel(pd.ExcelFile("Gogl2022_SupplementaryData1.xlsx"), "PDZ-PBM interactome",
                   usecols=["PDZ","peptide","COMP_neglogKd"])
df["pKd"] = pd.to_numeric(df.COMP_neglogKd, errors="coerce").fillna(0.0)
df["Pm2"] = df.peptide.astype(str).str.strip().str.upper().str[-3]
AAs = list("STYNQCGAVLIMFWPDEKRH")

def profile(domains):
    g = df[df.PDZ.isin(domains)]
    b = g[g.pKd>0].Pm2.value_counts(normalize=True)
    p = g.Pm2.value_counts(normalize=True)
    return pd.Series({a: np.log2((b.get(a,0)+1e-3)/(p.get(a,0)+1e-3)) for a in AAs})

pY, pH = profile(Y.pdz.tolist()), profile(H.pdz.tolist())
prof = pd.DataFrame({"Tyr_alphaB1 (NOS1, RADIL, ARHGAP21)": pY, "His_alphaB1 (71 domains)": pH})
prof.index.name = "P-2 residue"
prof.round(2).to_csv("profaff_Pminus2_preference_by_alphaB1.csv")
print("\nlog2 enrichment of each P-2 residue among binders vs tested panel:")
print(prof.round(2).to_string())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 5))
ax[0].hist(H.log2_OR_classI, bins=22, color="navy", alpha=.55, label="His at alphaB1 (n=71)")
for _, q in Y.iterrows():
    ax[0].axvline(q.log2_OR_classI, c="crimson", lw=1.6)
    ax[0].annotate(q.pdz, (q.log2_OR_classI, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.92), rotation=90,
                   fontsize=8, color="crimson", ha="right", va="top")
ax[0].axvline(0, ls="--", c="0.35", lw=1)
ax[0].set_xlabel("log2 OR, S/T at P-2 among binders"); ax[0].set_ylabel("domains")
ax[0].set_title("Tyr-alphaB1 domains prefer class I, more weakly than His")
ax[0].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)

x = np.arange(len(AAs))
ax[1].bar(x-0.2, pY.values, 0.4, color="crimson", label="Tyr at alphaB1")
ax[1].bar(x+0.2, pH.values, 0.4, color="navy", alpha=.7, label="His at alphaB1")
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(AAs, fontsize=9)
ax[1].axhline(0, c="0.35", lw=1); ax[1].set_xlabel("P-2 residue")
ax[1].set_ylabel("log2 enrichment among binders")
ax[1].set_title("Both read Ser/Thr at P-2; Tyr domains tolerate more alternatives")
ax[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
